verses.john 1:1: John 1:1 In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:2: John 1:2 He was in the beginning with God.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:3: John 1:3 All things were made through Him, and without Him nothing was made that was made.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:4: John 1:4 In Him was life, and the life was the light of men.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:5: John 1:5 And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness did not comprehend it.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:6: John 1:6 There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:7: John 1:7 This man came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all through him might believe.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:8: John 1:8 He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:9: John 1:9 That was the true Light which gives light to every man coming into the world.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:10: John 1:10 He was in the world, and the world was made through Him, and the world did not know Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:11: John 1:11 He came to His own, and His own did not receive Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:12: John 1:12 But as many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name:(NKJV)
verses.john 1:13: John 1:13 who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:14: John 1:14 And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we beheld His glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father, full of grace and truth.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:15: John 1:15 John bore witness of Him and cried out, saying, "This was He of whom I said, "˜He who comes after me is preferred before me, for He was before me.' "(NKJV)
verses.john 1:16: John 1:16 And of His fullness we have all received, and grace for grace.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:17: John 1:17 For the law was given through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:18: John 1:18 No one has seen God at any time. The only begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, He has declared Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:19: John 1:19 Now this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:20: John 1:20 He confessed, and did not deny, but confessed, "I am not the Christ."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:21: John 1:21 And they asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" And he answered, "No."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:22: John 1:22 Then they said to him, "Who are you, that we may give an answer to those who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:23: John 1:23 He said: "I am  "˜The voice of one crying in the wilderness: "Make straight the way of the LORD," '  as the prophet Isaiah said."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:24: John 1:24 Now those who were sent were from the Pharisees.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:25: John 1:25 And they asked him, saying, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:26: John 1:26 John answered them, saying, "I baptize with water, but there stands One among you whom you do not know.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:27: John 1:27 It is He who, coming after me, is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I am not worthy to loose."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:28: John 1:28 These things were done in Bethabara beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:29: John 1:29 The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, "Behold! The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!(NKJV)
verses.john 1:30: John 1:30 This is He of whom I said, "˜After me comes a Man who is preferred before me, for He was before me.'(NKJV)
verses.john 1:31: John 1:31 I did not know Him; but that He should be revealed to Israel, therefore I came baptizing with water."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:32: John 1:32 And John bore witness, saying, "I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and He remained upon Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:33: John 1:33 I did not know Him, but He who sent me to baptize with water said to me, "˜Upon whom you see the Spirit descending, and remaining on Him, this is He who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.'(NKJV)
verses.john 1:34: John 1:34 And I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:35: John 1:35 Again, the next day, John stood with two of his disciples.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:36: John 1:36 And looking at Jesus as He walked, he said, "Behold the Lamb of God!"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:37: John 1:37 The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:38: John 1:38 Then Jesus turned, and seeing them following, said to them, "What do you seek?" They said to Him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, when translated, Teacher), "where are You staying?"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:39: John 1:39 He said to them, "Come and see." They came and saw where He was staying, and remained with Him that day (now it was about the tenth hour).(NKJV)
verses.john 1:40: John 1:40 One of the two who heard John speak, and followed Him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:41: John 1:41 He first found his own brother Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah" (which is translated, the Christ).(NKJV)
verses.john 1:42: John 1:42 And he brought him to Jesus. Now when Jesus looked at him, He said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is translated, A Stone).(NKJV)
verses.john 1:43: John 1:43 The following day Jesus wanted to go to Galilee, and He found Philip and said to him, "Follow Me."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:44: John 1:44 Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.(NKJV)
verses.john 1:45: John 1:45 Philip found Nathanael and said to him, "We have found Him of whom Moses in the law, and also the prophets, wrote"”Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:46: John 1:46 And Nathanael said to him, "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:47: John 1:47 Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him, and said of him, "Behold,  an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:48: John 1:48 Nathanael said to Him, "How do You know me?" Jesus answered and said to him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:49: John 1:49 Nathanael answered and said to Him, "Rabbi, You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!"(NKJV)
verses.john 1:50: John 1:50 Jesus answered and said to him, "Because I said to you, "˜I saw you under the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these."(NKJV)
verses.john 1:51: John 1:51 And He said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you,  hereafter you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:1: John 2:1 On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:2: John 2:2 Now both Jesus and His disciples were invited to the wedding.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:3: John 2:3 And when they ran out of wine, the mother of Jesus said to Him, "They have no wine."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:4: John 2:4 Jesus said to her, "Woman,  what does your concern have to do with Me?  My hour has not yet come."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:5: John 2:5 His mother said to the servants, "Whatever He says to you, do it."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:6: John 2:6 Now there were set there six waterpots of stone, according to the manner of purification of the Jews, containing twenty or thirty gallons apiece.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:7: John 2:7 Jesus said to them, "Fill the waterpots with water." And they filled them up to the brim.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:8: John 2:8 And He said to them, "Draw some out now, and take it to the master of the feast." And they took it.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:9: John 2:9 When the master of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and did not know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the master of the feast called the bridegroom.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:10: John 2:10 And he said to him, "Every man at the beginning sets out the good wine, and when the guests have well drunk, then the inferior. You have kept the good wine until now!"(NKJV)
verses.john 2:11: John 2:11 This beginning of signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and manifested His glory; and His disciples believed in Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:12: John 2:12 After this He went down to Capernaum, He, His mother, His brothers, and His disciples; and they did not stay there many days.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:13: John 2:13 Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:14: John 2:14 And He found in the temple those who sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the money changers doing business.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:15: John 2:15 When He had made a whip of cords, He drove them all out of the temple, with the sheep and the oxen, and poured out the changers' money and overturned the tables.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:16: John 2:16 And He said to those who sold doves, "Take these things away! Do not make  My Father's house a house of merchandise!"(NKJV)
verses.john 2:17: John 2:17 Then His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for Your house has eaten Me up."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:18: John 2:18 So the Jews answered and said to Him, "What sign do You show to us, since You do these things?"(NKJV)
verses.john 2:19: John 2:19 Jesus answered and said to them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."(NKJV)
verses.john 2:20: John 2:20 Then the Jews said, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and will You raise it up in three days?"(NKJV)
verses.john 2:21: John 2:21 But He was speaking of the temple of His body.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:22: John 2:22 Therefore, when He had risen from the dead, His disciples remembered that He had said this to them; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:23: John 2:23 Now when He was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in His name when they saw the signs which He did.(NKJV)
verses.john 2:24: John 2:24 But Jesus did not commit Himself to them, because He knew all men,(NKJV)
verses.john 2:25: John 2:25 and had no need that anyone should testify of man, for He knew what was in man.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:1: John 3:1 There was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:2: John 3:2 This man came to Jesus by night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that You do unless God is with him."(NKJV)
verses.john 3:3: John 3:3 Jesus answered and said to him, "Most assuredly, I say to you,  unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."(NKJV)
verses.john 3:4: John 3:4 Nicodemus said to Him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb and be born?"(NKJV)
verses.john 3:5: John 3:5 Jesus answered, "Most assuredly, I say to you,  unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:6: John 3:6 That which is born of the flesh is  flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:7: John 3:7 Do not marvel that I said to you, "˜You must be born again.'(NKJV)
verses.john 3:8: John 3:8 The wind blows where it wishes, and you hear the sound of it, but cannot tell where it comes from and where it goes. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."(NKJV)
verses.john 3:9: John 3:9 Nicodemus answered and said to Him, "How can these things be?"(NKJV)
verses.john 3:10: John 3:10 Jesus answered and said to him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and do not know these things?(NKJV)
verses.john 3:11: John 3:11 Most assuredly, I say to you, We speak what We know and testify what We have seen, and  you do not receive Our witness.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:12: John 3:12 If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?(NKJV)
verses.john 3:13: John 3:13 No one has ascended to heaven but He who came down from heaven, that is, the Son of Man who is in heaven.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:14: John 3:14 And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so  must the Son of Man be lifted up,(NKJV)
verses.john 3:15: John 3:15 that whoever  believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:16: John 3:16 For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten  Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:17: John 3:17 For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world through Him might be saved.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:18: John 3:18 "He who believes in Him is not condemned; but he who does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:19: John 3:19 And this is the condemnation,  that the light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:20: John 3:20 For  everyone practicing evil hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his deeds should be exposed.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:21: John 3:21 But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be clearly seen, that they have been  done in God."(NKJV)
verses.john 3:22: John 3:22 After these things Jesus and His disciples came into the land of Judea, and there He remained with them and baptized.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:23: John 3:23 Now John also was baptizing in Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there. And they came and were baptized.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:24: John 3:24 For John had not yet been thrown into prison.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:25: John 3:25 Then there arose a dispute between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purification.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:26: John 3:26 And they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi, He who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified"”behold, He is baptizing, and all are coming to Him!"(NKJV)
verses.john 3:27: John 3:27 John answered and said, "A man can receive nothing unless it has been given to him from heaven.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:28: John 3:28 You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, "˜I am not the Christ,' but, "˜I have been sent before Him.'(NKJV)
verses.john 3:29: John 3:29 He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. Therefore this joy of mine is fulfilled.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:30: John 3:30 He must increase, but I must decrease.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:31: John 3:31 He who comes from above is above all; he who is of the earth is earthly and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:32: John 3:32 And what He has seen and heard, that He testifies; and no one receives His testimony.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:33: John 3:33 He who has received His testimony has certified that God is true.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:34: John 3:34 For He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God does not give the Spirit by measure.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:35: John 3:35 The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into His hand.(NKJV)
verses.john 3:36: John 3:36 He who believes in the Son has everlasting life; and he who does not believe the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God abides on him."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:1: John 4:1 Therefore, when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John(NKJV)
verses.john 4:2: John 4:2 (though Jesus Himself did not baptize, but His disciples),(NKJV)
verses.john 4:3: John 4:3 He left Judea and departed again to Galilee.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:4: John 4:4 But He needed to go through Samaria.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:5: John 4:5 So He came to a city of Samaria which is called Sychar, near the plot of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:6: John 4:6 Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied from His journey, sat thus by the well. It was about the sixth hour.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:7: John 4:7 A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give Me a drink."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:8: John 4:8 For His disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:9: John 4:9 Then the woman of Samaria said to Him, "How is it that You, being a Jew, ask a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:10: John 4:10 Jesus answered and said to her, "If you knew the  gift of God, and who it is who says to you, "˜Give Me a drink,' you would have asked Him, and He would have given you  living water."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:11: John 4:11 The woman said to Him, "Sir, You have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. Where then do You get that living water?(NKJV)
verses.john 4:12: John 4:12 Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, as well as his sons and his livestock?"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:13: John 4:13 Jesus answered and said to her, "Whoever drinks of this water will thirst again,(NKJV)
verses.john 4:14: John 4:14 but  whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst. But the water that I shall give him  will become in him a fountain of water springing up into everlasting life."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:15: John 4:15 The woman said to Him, "Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come here to draw."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:16: John 4:16 Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:17: John 4:17 The woman answered and said, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You have well said, "˜I have no husband,'(NKJV)
verses.john 4:18: John 4:18 for you have had five husbands, and the one whom you now have is not your husband; in that you spoke truly."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:19: John 4:19 The woman said to Him, "Sir, I perceive that You are a prophet.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:20: John 4:20 Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where one ought to worship."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:21: John 4:21 Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe Me, the hour is coming  when you will neither on this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, worship the Father.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:22: John 4:22 You worship  what you do not know; we know what we worship, for  salvation is of the Jews.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:23: John 4:23 But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will  worship the Father in  spirit  and truth; for the Father is seeking such to worship Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:24: John 4:24 God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:25: John 4:25 The woman said to Him, "I know that Messiah is coming" (who is called Christ). "When He comes, He will tell us all things."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:26: John 4:26 Jesus said to her, "I who speak to you am He."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:27: John 4:27 And at this point His disciples came, and they marveled that He talked with a woman; yet no one said, "What do You seek?" or, "Why are You talking with her?"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:28: John 4:28 The woman then left her waterpot, went her way into the city, and said to the men,(NKJV)
verses.john 4:29: John 4:29 "Come, see a Man who told me all things that I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:30: John 4:30 Then they went out of the city and came to Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:31: John 4:31 In the meantime His disciples urged Him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:32: John 4:32 But He said to them, "I have food to eat of which you do not know."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:33: John 4:33 Therefore the disciples said to one another, "Has anyone brought Him anything to eat?"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:34: John 4:34 Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me, and to  finish His work.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:35: John 4:35 Do you not say, "˜There are still four months and then comes  the harvest'? Behold, I say to you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields,  for they are already white for harvest!(NKJV)
verses.john 4:36: John 4:36 And he who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit for eternal life, that  both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:37: John 4:37 For in this the saying is true:  "˜One sows and another reaps.'(NKJV)
verses.john 4:38: John 4:38 I sent you to reap that for which you have not labored;  others have labored, and you have entered into their labors."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:39: John 4:39 And many of the Samaritans of that city believed in Him because of the word of the woman who testified, "He told me all that I ever did."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:40: John 4:40 So when the Samaritans had come to Him, they urged Him to stay with them; and He stayed there two days.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:41: John 4:41 And many more believed because of His own word.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:42: John 4:42 Then they said to the woman, "Now we believe, not because of what you said, for we ourselves have heard Him and we know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:43: John 4:43 Now after the two days He departed from there and went to Galilee.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:44: John 4:44 For Jesus Himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:45: John 4:45 So when He came to Galilee, the Galileans received Him, having seen all the things He did in Jerusalem at the feast; for they also had gone to the feast.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:46: John 4:46 So Jesus came again to Cana of Galilee where He had made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:47: John 4:47 When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to Him and implored Him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:48: John 4:48 Then Jesus said to him, "Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will by no means believe."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:49: John 4:49 The nobleman said to Him, "Sir, come down before my child dies!"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:50: John 4:50 Jesus said to him, "Go your way; your son lives." So the man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:51: John 4:51 And as he was now going down, his servants met him and told him, saying, "Your son lives!"(NKJV)
verses.john 4:52: John 4:52 Then he inquired of them the hour when he got better. And they said to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him."(NKJV)
verses.john 4:53: John 4:53 So the father knew that it was at the same hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives." And he himself believed, and his whole household.(NKJV)
verses.john 4:54: John 4:54 This again is the second sign Jesus did when He had come out of Judea into Galilee.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:1: John 5:1 After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:2: John 5:2 Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:3: John 5:3 In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:4: John 5:4 For an angel went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:5: John 5:5 Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:6: John 5:6 When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been in that condition a long time, He said to him, "Do you want to be made well?"(NKJV)
verses.john 5:7: John 5:7 The sick man answered Him, "Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me."(NKJV)
verses.john 5:8: John 5:8 Jesus said to him, "Rise, take up your bed and walk."(NKJV)
verses.john 5:9: John 5:9 And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked. And that day was the Sabbath.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:10: John 5:10 The Jews therefore said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath; it is not lawful for you to carry your bed."(NKJV)
verses.john 5:11: John 5:11 He answered them, "He who made me well said to me, "˜Take up your bed and walk.' "(NKJV)
verses.john 5:12: John 5:12 Then they asked him, "Who is the Man who said to you, "˜Take up your bed and walk'?"(NKJV)
verses.john 5:13: John 5:13 But the one who was healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a multitude being in that place.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:14: John 5:14 Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "See, you have been made well.  Sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon you."(NKJV)
verses.john 5:15: John 5:15 The man departed and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:16: John 5:16 For this reason the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the Sabbath.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:17: John 5:17 But Jesus answered them, "My Father has been working until now, and I have been working."(NKJV)
verses.john 5:18: John 5:18 Therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill Him, because He not only broke the Sabbath, but also said that God was His Father, making Himself equal with God.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:19: John 5:19 Then Jesus answered and said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you,  the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees the Father do; for whatever He does, the Son also does in like manner.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:20: John 5:20 For  the Father loves the Son, and  shows Him all things that He Himself does; and He will show Him greater works than these, that you may marvel.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:21: John 5:21 For as the Father raises the dead and gives life to them, even so the Son gives life to whom He will.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:22: John 5:22 For the Father judges no one, but  has committed all judgment to the Son,(NKJV)
verses.john 5:23: John 5:23 that all should honor the Son just as they honor the Father.  He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:24: John 5:24 "Most assuredly, I say to you,  he who hears My word and believes in Him who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment,  but has passed from death into life.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:25: John 5:25 Most assuredly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when  the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God; and those who hear will live.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:26: John 5:26 For  as the Father has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have  life in Himself,(NKJV)
verses.john 5:27: John 5:27 and  has given Him authority to execute judgment also,  because He is the Son of Man.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:28: John 5:28 Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves will  hear His voice(NKJV)
verses.john 5:29: John 5:29 and come forth"” those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of condemnation.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:30: John 5:30 I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because  I do not seek My own will but the will of the Father who sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:31: John 5:31 "If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:32: John 5:32 There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which He witnesses of Me is true.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:33: John 5:33 You have sent to John,  and he has borne witness to the truth.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:34: John 5:34 Yet I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things that you may be saved.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:35: John 5:35 He was the burning and  shining lamp, and  you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:36: John 5:36 But  I have a greater witness than John's; for  the works which the Father has given Me to finish"”the very  works that I do"”bear witness of Me, that the Father has sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:37: John 5:37 And the Father Himself, who sent Me,  has testified of Me. You have neither heard His voice at any time,  nor seen His form.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:38: John 5:38 But you do not have His word abiding in you, because whom He sent, Him you do not believe.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:39: John 5:39 You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and  these are they which testify of Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:40: John 5:40 But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:41: John 5:41 "I do not receive honor from men.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:42: John 5:42 But I know you, that you do not have the love of God in you.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:43: John 5:43 I have come in My Father's name, and you do not receive Me; if another comes in his own name, him you will receive.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:44: John 5:44 How can you believe, who receive honor from one another, and do not seek  the honor that comes from the only God?(NKJV)
verses.john 5:45: John 5:45 Do not think that I shall accuse you to the Father;  there is one who accuses you"”Moses, in whom you trust.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:46: John 5:46 For if you believed Moses, you would believe Me;  for he wrote about Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 5:47: John 5:47 But if you  do not believe his writings, how will you believe My words?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:1: John 6:1 After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, which is the Sea of Tiberias.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:2: John 6:2 Then a great multitude followed Him, because they saw His signs which He performed on those who were diseased.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:3: John 6:3 And Jesus went up on the mountain, and there He sat with His disciples.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:4: John 6:4 Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:5: John 6:5 Then Jesus lifted up His eyes, and seeing a great multitude coming toward Him, He said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread, that these may eat?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:6: John 6:6 But this He said to test him, for He Himself knew what He would do.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:7: John 6:7 Philip answered Him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may have a little."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:8: John 6:8 One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to Him,(NKJV)
verses.john 6:9: John 6:9 "There is a lad here who has five barley loaves and two small fish, but what are they among so many?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:10: John 6:10 Then Jesus said, "Make the people sit down." Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:11: John 6:11 And Jesus took the loaves, and when He had given thanks He distributed them to the disciples, and the disciples to those sitting down; and likewise of the fish, as much as they wanted.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:12: John 6:12 So when they were filled, He said to His disciples, "Gather up the fragments that remain, so that nothing is lost."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:13: John 6:13 Therefore they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves which were left over by those who had eaten.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:14: John 6:14 Then those men, when they had seen the sign that Jesus did, said, "This is truly the Prophet who is to come into the world."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:15: John 6:15 Therefore when Jesus perceived that they were about to come and take Him by force to make Him king, He departed again to the mountain by Himself alone.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:16: John 6:16 Now when evening came, His disciples went down to the sea,(NKJV)
verses.john 6:17: John 6:17 got into the boat, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was already dark, and Jesus had not come to them.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:18: John 6:18 Then the sea arose because a great wind was blowing.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:19: John 6:19 So when they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near the boat; and they were afraid.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:20: John 6:20 But He said to them, "It is I; do not be afraid."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:21: John 6:21 Then they willingly received Him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:22: John 6:22 On the following day, when the people who were standing on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except that one which His disciples had entered, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with His disciples, but His disciples had gone away alone"”(NKJV)
verses.john 6:23: John 6:23 however, other boats came from Tiberias, near the place where they ate bread after the Lord had given thanks"”(NKJV)
verses.john 6:24: John 6:24 when the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, nor His disciples, they also got into boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:25: John 6:25 And when they found Him on the other side of the sea, they said to Him, "Rabbi, when did You come here?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:26: John 6:26 Jesus answered them and said, "Most assuredly, I say to you, you seek Me, not because you saw the signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:27: John 6:27 Do not labor for the food which perishes, but  for the food which endures to everlasting life, which the Son of Man will give you,  because God the Father has set His seal on Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:28: John 6:28 Then they said to Him, "What shall we do, that we may work the works of God?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:29: John 6:29 Jesus answered and said to them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in Him whom He sent."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:30: John 6:30 Therefore they said to Him, "What sign will You perform then, that we may see it and believe You? What work will You do?(NKJV)
verses.john 6:31: John 6:31 Our fathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written, "˜He gave them bread from heaven to eat.' "(NKJV)
verses.john 6:32: John 6:32 Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread from heaven, but  My Father gives you the true bread from heaven.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:33: John 6:33 For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:34: John 6:34 Then they said to Him, "Lord, give us this bread always."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:35: John 6:35 And Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life.  He who comes to Me shall never hunger, and he who believes in Me shall never  thirst.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:36: John 6:36 But I said to you that you have seen Me and yet  do not believe.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:37: John 6:37 All that the Father gives Me will come to Me, and  the one who comes to Me I will by no means cast out.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:38: John 6:38 For I have come down from heaven,  not to do My own will,  but the will of Him who sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:39: John 6:39 This is the will of the Father who sent Me,  that of all He has given Me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up at the last day.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:40: John 6:40 And this is the will of Him who sent Me,  that everyone who sees the Son and believes in Him may have everlasting life; and I will raise him up at the last day."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:41: John 6:41 The Jews then complained about Him, because He said, "I am the bread which came down from heaven."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:42: John 6:42 And they said, "Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How is it then that He says, "˜I have come down from heaven'?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:43: John 6:43 Jesus therefore answered and said to them, "Do not murmur among yourselves.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:44: John 6:44 No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me  draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:45: John 6:45 It is written in the prophets,  "˜And they shall all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who has heard and learned from the Father comes to Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:46: John 6:46 Not that anyone has seen the Father,  except He who is from God; He has seen the Father.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:47: John 6:47 Most assuredly, I say to you,  he who believes in Me has everlasting life.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:48: John 6:48 I am the bread of life.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:49: John 6:49 Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and are dead.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:50: John 6:50 This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that one may eat of it and not die.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:51: John 6:51 I am the living bread  which came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever; and  the bread that I shall give is My flesh, which I shall give for the life of the world."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:52: John 6:52 The Jews therefore quarreled among themselves, saying, "How can this Man give us His flesh to eat?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:53: John 6:53 Then Jesus said to them, "Most assuredly, I say to you, unless  you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, you have no life in you.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:54: John 6:54 Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:55: John 6:55 For My flesh is food indeed, and My blood is drink indeed.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:56: John 6:56 He who eats My flesh and drinks My blood  abides in Me, and I in him.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:57: John 6:57 As the living Father sent Me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on Me will live because of Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:58: John 6:58 This is the bread which came down from heaven"”not  as your fathers ate the manna, and are dead. He who eats this bread will live forever."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:59: John 6:59 These things He said in the synagogue as He taught in Capernaum.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:60: John 6:60 Therefore many of His disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying; who can understand it?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:61: John 6:61 When Jesus knew in Himself that His disciples complained about this, He said to them, "Does this offend you?(NKJV)
verses.john 6:62: John 6:62 What then if you should see the Son of Man ascend where He was before?(NKJV)
verses.john 6:63: John 6:63 It is the Spirit who gives life; the  flesh profits nothing. The  words that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:64: John 6:64 But  there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who did not believe, and who would betray Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:65: John 6:65 And He said, "Therefore  I have said to you that no one can come to Me unless it has been granted to him by My Father."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:66: John 6:66 From that time many of His disciples went back and walked with Him no more.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:67: John 6:67 Then Jesus said to the twelve, "Do you also want to go away?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:68: John 6:68 But Simon Peter answered Him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.(NKJV)
verses.john 6:69: John 6:69 Also we have come to believe and know that You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."(NKJV)
verses.john 6:70: John 6:70 Jesus answered them, "Did I not choose you, the twelve,  and one of you is a devil?"(NKJV)
verses.john 6:71: John 6:71 He spoke of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, for it was he who would betray Him, being one of the twelve.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:1: John 7:1 After these things Jesus walked in Galilee; for He did not want to walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:2: John 7:2 Now the Jews' Feast of Tabernacles was at hand.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:3: John 7:3 His brothers therefore said to Him, "Depart from here and go into Judea, that Your disciples also may see the works that You are doing.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:4: John 7:4 For no one does anything in secret while he himself seeks to be known openly. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:5: John 7:5 For even His brothers did not believe in Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:6: John 7:6 Then Jesus said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:7: John 7:7 The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me  because I testify of it that its works are evil.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:8: John 7:8 You go up to this feast. I am not yet going up to this feast,  for My time has not yet fully come."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:9: John 7:9 When He had said these things to them, He remained in Galilee.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:10: John 7:10 But when His brothers had gone up, then He also went up to the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:11: John 7:11 Then the Jews sought Him at the feast, and said, "Where is He?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:12: John 7:12 And there was much complaining among the people concerning Him. Some said, "He is good"; others said, "No, on the contrary, He deceives the people."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:13: John 7:13 However, no one spoke openly of Him for fear of the Jews.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:14: John 7:14 Now about the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and taught.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:15: John 7:15 And the Jews marveled, saying, "How does this Man know letters, having never studied?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:16: John 7:16 Jesus answered them and said, "My doctrine is not Mine, but His who sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:17: John 7:17 If anyone wills to do His will, he shall know concerning the doctrine, whether it is from God or whether I speak on My own authority.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:18: John 7:18 He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory; but He who  seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is true, and  no unrighteousness is in Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:19: John 7:19 Did not Moses give you the law, yet none of you keeps the law?  Why do you seek to kill Me?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:20: John 7:20 The people answered and said, "You have a demon. Who is seeking to kill You?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:21: John 7:21 Jesus answered and said to them, "I did one work, and you all marvel.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:22: John 7:22 Moses therefore gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses,  but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man on the Sabbath.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:23: John 7:23 If a man receives circumcision on the Sabbath, so that the law of Moses should not be broken, are you angry with Me because  I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:24: John 7:24 Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:25: John 7:25 Now some of them from Jerusalem said, "Is this not He whom they seek to kill?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:26: John 7:26 But look! He speaks boldly, and they say nothing to Him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is truly the Christ?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:27: John 7:27 However, we know where this Man is from; but when the Christ comes, no one knows where He is from."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:28: John 7:28 Then Jesus cried out, as He taught in the temple, saying, "You both know Me, and you know where I am from; and  I have not come of Myself, but He who sent Me  is true,  whom you do not know.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:29: John 7:29 But I know Him, for I am from Him, and He sent Me."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:30: John 7:30 Therefore they sought to take Him; but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:31: John 7:31 And many of the people believed in Him, and said, "When the Christ comes, will He do more signs than these which this Man has done?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:32: John 7:32 The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things concerning Him, and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:33: John 7:33 Then Jesus said to them, "I shall be with you a little while longer, and then I  go to Him who sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:34: John 7:34 You  will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you  cannot come."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:35: John 7:35 Then the Jews said among themselves, "Where does He intend to go that we shall not find Him? Does He intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:36: John 7:36 What is this thing that He said, "˜You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come'?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:37: John 7:37 On the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, "If anyone thirsts, let him come to Me and drink.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:38: John 7:38 He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said,  out of his heart will flow rivers of living water."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:39: John 7:39 But this He spoke concerning the Spirit, whom those believing in Him would receive; for the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:40: John 7:40 Therefore many from the crowd, when they heard this saying, said, "Truly this is the Prophet."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:41: John 7:41 Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "Will the Christ come out of Galilee?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:42: John 7:42 Has not the Scripture said that the Christ comes from the seed of David and from the town of Bethlehem, where David was?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:43: John 7:43 So there was a division among the people because of Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:44: John 7:44 Now some of them wanted to take Him, but no one laid hands on Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 7:45: John 7:45 Then the officers came to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, "Why have you not brought Him?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:46: John 7:46 The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this Man!"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:47: John 7:47 Then the Pharisees answered them, "Are you also deceived?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:48: John 7:48 Have any of the rulers or the Pharisees believed in Him?(NKJV)
verses.john 7:49: John 7:49 But this crowd that does not know the law is accursed."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:50: John 7:50 Nicodemus (he who came to Jesus by night, being one of them) said to them,(NKJV)
verses.john 7:51: John 7:51 "Does our law judge a man before it hears him and knows what he is doing?"(NKJV)
verses.john 7:52: John 7:52 They answered and said to him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search and look, for no prophet has arisen out of Galilee."(NKJV)
verses.john 7:53: John 7:53 And everyone went to his own house.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:1: John 8:1 But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:2: John 8:2 Now early in the morning He came again into the temple, and all the people came to Him; and He sat down and taught them.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:3: John 8:3 Then the scribes and Pharisees brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. And when they had set her in the midst,(NKJV)
verses.john 8:4: John 8:4 they said to Him, "Teacher, this woman was caught in adultery, in the very act.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:5: John 8:5 Now Moses, in the law, commanded us that such should be stoned. But what do You say?"(NKJV)
verses.john 8:6: John 8:6 This they said, testing Him, that they might have something of which to accuse Him. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with His finger, as though He did not hear.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:7: John 8:7 So when they continued asking Him, He raised Himself up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him throw a stone at her first."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:8: John 8:8 And again He stooped down and wrote on the ground.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:9: John 8:9 Then those who heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning with the oldest even to the last. And Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:10: John 8:10 When Jesus had raised Himself up and saw no one but the woman, He said to her, "Woman, where are those accusers of yours? Has no one condemned you?"(NKJV)
verses.john 8:11: John 8:11 She said, "No one, Lord." And Jesus said to her, "Neither do I condemn you; go and sin no more."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:12: John 8:12 Then Jesus spoke to them again, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who  follows Me shall not walk in darkness, but have the light of life."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:13: John 8:13 The Pharisees therefore said to Him, "You bear witness of Yourself; Your witness is not true."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:14: John 8:14 Jesus answered and said to them, "Even if I bear witness of Myself, My witness is true, for I know where I came from and where I am going; but  you do not know where I come from and where I am going.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:15: John 8:15 You judge according to the flesh;  I judge no one.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:16: John 8:16 And yet if I do judge, My judgment is true; for  I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:17: John 8:17 It is also written in your law that the testimony of two men is true.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:18: John 8:18 I am One who bears witness of Myself, and  the Father who sent Me bears witness of Me."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:19: John 8:19 Then they said to Him, "Where is Your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither Me nor My Father.  If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:20: John 8:20 These words Jesus spoke in the treasury, as He taught in the temple; and no one laid hands on Him, for His hour had not yet come.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:21: John 8:21 Then Jesus said to them again, "I am going away, and  you will seek Me, and  will die in your sin. Where I go you cannot come."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:22: John 8:22 So the Jews said, "Will He kill Himself, because He says, "˜Where I go you cannot come'?"(NKJV)
verses.john 8:23: John 8:23 And He said to them, "You are from beneath; I am from above.  You are of this world; I am not of this world.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:24: John 8:24 Therefore I said to you that you will die in your sins;  for if you do not believe that I am He, you will die in your sins."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:25: John 8:25 Then they said to Him, "Who are You?" And Jesus said to them, "Just what I  have been saying to you from the beginning.(NKJV)
verses.john 8:26: John 8:26 I have many things to say and to judge concerning you, but  He who sent Me is true; and  I speak to the world those things which I heard from Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 8:27: John 8:27 They did not understand that He spoke to them of the Father.(NKJV)

verses.john 17:1: John 17:1 Jesus spoke these words, lifted up His eyes to heaven, and said: "Father,  the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son also may glorify You,(NKJV)
verses.john 17:2: John 17:2 as You have given Him authority over all flesh, that He should give eternal life to as many  as You have given Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:3: John 17:3 And  this is eternal life, that they may know You,  the only true God, and Jesus Christ  whom You have sent.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:4: John 17:4 I have glorified You on the earth.  I have finished the work  which You have given Me to do.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:5: John 17:5 And now, O Father, glorify Me together with Yourself, with the glory  which I had with You before the world was.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:6: John 17:6 "I have manifested Your name to the men  whom You have given Me out of the world.  They were Yours, You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:7: John 17:7 Now they have known that all things which You have given Me are from You.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:8: John 17:8 For I have given to them the words  which You have given Me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came forth from You; and they have believed that  You sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:9: John 17:9 "I pray for them.  I do not pray for the world but for those whom You have given Me, for they are Yours.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:10: John 17:10 And all Mine are Yours, and  Yours are Mine, and I am glorified in them.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:11: John 17:11 Now I am no longer in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to You. Holy Father,  keep through Your name those whom You have given Me, that they may be one  as We are.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:12: John 17:12 While I was with them in the world, I kept them in Your name. Those whom You gave Me I have kept; and  none of them is lost  except the son of perdition,  that the Scripture might be fulfilled.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:13: John 17:13 But now I come to You, and these things I speak in the world, that they may have My joy fulfilled in themselves.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:14: John 17:14 I have given them Your word;  and the world has hated them because they are not of the world,  just as I am not of the world.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:15: John 17:15 I do not pray that You should take them out of the world, but  that You should keep them from the evil one.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:16: John 17:16 They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:17: John 17:17 Sanctify them by Your truth.  Your word is truth.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:18: John 17:18 As You sent Me into the world, I also have sent them into the world.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:19: John 17:19 And  for their sakes I sanctify Myself, that they also may be sanctified by the truth.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:20: John 17:20 "I do not pray for these alone, but also for those who will believe in Me through their word;(NKJV)
verses.john 17:21: John 17:21 that they all may be one, as  You, Father, are in Me, and I in You; that they also may be one in Us, that the world may believe that You sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:22: John 17:22 And the  glory which You gave Me I have given them,  that they may be one just as We are one:(NKJV)
verses.john 17:23: John 17:23 I in them, and You in Me;  that they may be made perfect in one, and that the world may know that You have sent Me, and have loved them as You have loved Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:24: John 17:24 "Father, I desire that they also whom You gave Me may be with Me where I am, that they may behold My glory which You have given Me;  for You loved Me before the foundation of the world.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:25: John 17:25 O righteous Father!  The world has not known You, but  I have known You; and  these have known that You sent Me.(NKJV)
verses.john 17:26: John 17:26 And I have declared to them Your name, and will declare it, that the love  with which You loved Me may be in them, and I in them."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:1: John 18:1 When Jesus had spoken these words, He went out with His disciples over the Brook Kidron, where there was a garden, which He and His disciples entered.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:2: John 18:2 And Judas, who betrayed Him, also knew the place; for Jesus often met there with His disciples.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:3: John 18:3 Then Judas, having received a detachment of troops, and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:4: John 18:4 Jesus therefore, knowing all things that would come upon Him, went forward and said to them, "Whom are you seeking?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:5: John 18:5 They answered Him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am He." And Judas, who betrayed Him, also stood with them.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:6: John 18:6 Now when He said to them, "I am He," they drew back and fell to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:7: John 18:7 Then He asked them again, "Whom are you seeking?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:8: John 18:8 Jesus answered, "I have told you that I am He. Therefore, if you seek Me, let these go their way,"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:9: John 18:9 that the saying might be fulfilled which He spoke, "Of those whom You gave Me I have lost none."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:10: John 18:10 Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:11: John 18:11 So Jesus said to Peter, "Put your sword into the sheath. Shall I not drink  the cup which My Father has given Me?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:12: John 18:12 Then the detachment of troops and the captain and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:13: John 18:13 And they led Him away to Annas first, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas who was high priest that year.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:14: John 18:14 Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:15: John 18:15 And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and went with Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:16: John 18:16 But Peter stood at the door outside. Then the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought Peter in.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:17: John 18:17 Then the servant girl who kept the door said to Peter, "You are not also one of this Man's disciples, are you?" He said, "I am not."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:18: John 18:18 Now the servants and officers who had made a fire of coals stood there, for it was cold, and they warmed themselves. And Peter stood with them and warmed himself.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:19: John 18:19 The high priest then asked Jesus about His disciples and His doctrine.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:20: John 18:20 Jesus answered him, "I spoke openly to the world. I always taught  in synagogues and  in the temple, where the Jews always meet, and in secret I have said nothing.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:21: John 18:21 Why do you ask Me? Ask  those who have heard Me what I said to them. Indeed they know what I said."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:22: John 18:22 And when He had said these things, one of the officers who stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, "Do You answer the high priest like that?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:23: John 18:23 Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil; but if well, why do you strike Me?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:24: John 18:24 Then Annas sent Him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:25: John 18:25 Now Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. Therefore they said to him, "You are not also one of His disciples, are you?" He denied it and said, "I am not!"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:26: John 18:26 One of the servants of the high priest, a relative of him whose ear Peter cut off, said, "Did I not see you in the garden with Him?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:27: John 18:27 Peter then denied again; and immediately a rooster crowed.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:28: John 18:28 Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas to the Praetorium, and it was early morning. But they themselves did not go into the Praetorium, lest they should be defiled, but that they might eat the Passover.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:29: John 18:29 Pilate then went out to them and said, "What accusation do you bring against this Man?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:30: John 18:30 They answered and said to him, "If He were not an evildoer, we would not have delivered Him up to you."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:31: John 18:31 Then Pilate said to them, "You take Him and judge Him according to your law." Therefore the Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:32: John 18:32 that the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled which He spoke, signifying by what death He would die.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:33: John 18:33 Then Pilate entered the Praetorium again, called Jesus, and said to Him, "Are You the King of the Jews?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:34: John 18:34 Jesus answered him, "Are you speaking for yourself about this, or did others tell you this concerning Me?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:35: John 18:35 Pilate answered, "Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have delivered You to me. What have You done?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:36: John 18:36 Jesus answered, "My kingdom is not of this world. If My kingdom were of this world, My servants would fight, so that I should not be delivered to the Jews; but now My kingdom is not from here."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:37: John 18:37 Pilate therefore said to Him, "Are You a king then?" Jesus answered, "You say rightly that I am a king. For this cause I was born, and for this cause I have come into the world,  that I should bear  witness to the truth. Everyone who  is of the truth  hears My voice."(NKJV)
verses.john 18:38: John 18:38 Pilate said to Him, "What is truth?" And when he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, "I find no fault in Him at all.(NKJV)
verses.john 18:39: John 18:39 "But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Do you therefore want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"(NKJV)
verses.john 18:40: John 18:40 Then they all cried again, saying, "Not this Man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:1: John 19:1 So then Pilate took Jesus and scourged Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:2: John 19:2 And the soldiers twisted a crown of thorns and put it on His head, and they put on Him a purple robe.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:3: John 19:3 Then they said, "Hail, King of the Jews!" And they struck Him with their hands.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:4: John 19:4 Pilate then went out again, and said to them, "Behold, I am bringing Him out to you, that you may know that I find no fault in Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:5: John 19:5 Then Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, "Behold the Man!"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:6: John 19:6 Therefore, when the chief priests and officers saw Him, they cried out, saying, "Crucify Him, crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "You take Him and crucify Him, for I find no fault in Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:7: John 19:7 The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and according to our law He ought to die, because He made Himself the Son of God."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:8: John 19:8 Therefore, when Pilate heard that saying, he was the more afraid,(NKJV)
verses.john 19:9: John 19:9 and went again into the Praetorium, and said to Jesus, "Where are You from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:10: John 19:10 Then Pilate said to Him, "Are You not speaking to me? Do You not know that I have power to crucify You, and power to release You?"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:11: John 19:11 Jesus answered, "You could have no power at all against Me unless it had been given you from above. Therefore  the one who delivered Me to you has the greater sin."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:12: John 19:12 From then on Pilate sought to release Him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you let this Man go, you are not Caesar's friend. Whoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:13: John 19:13 When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus out and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:14: John 19:14 Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, and about the sixth hour. And he said to the Jews, "Behold your King!"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:15: John 19:15 But they cried out, "Away with Him, away with Him! Crucify Him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:16: John 19:16 Then he delivered Him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led Him away.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:17: John 19:17 And He, bearing His cross, went out to a place called the Place of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha,(NKJV)
verses.john 19:18: John 19:18 where they crucified Him, and two others with Him, one on either side, and Jesus in the center.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:19: John 19:19 Now Pilate wrote a title and put it on the cross. And the writing was: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:20: John 19:20 Then many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:21: John 19:21 Therefore the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, "Do not write, "˜The King of the Jews,' but, "˜He said, "I am the King of the Jews." ' "(NKJV)
verses.john 19:22: John 19:22 Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:23: John 19:23 Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took His garments and made four parts, to each soldier a part, and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top in one piece.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:24: John 19:24 They said therefore among themselves, "Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be," that the Scripture might be fulfilled which says:  "They divided My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots."  Therefore the soldiers did these things.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:25: John 19:25 Now there stood by the cross of Jesus His mother, and His mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:26: John 19:26 When Jesus therefore saw His mother, and the disciple whom He loved standing by, He said to His mother, "Woman, behold your son!"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:27: John 19:27 Then He said to the disciple, "Behold your mother!" And from that hour that disciple took her to his own home.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:28: John 19:28 After this, Jesus, knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I thirst!"(NKJV)
verses.john 19:29: John 19:29 Now a vessel full of sour wine was sitting there; and they filled a sponge with sour wine, put it on hyssop, and put it to His mouth.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:30: John 19:30 So when Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, "It is finished!" And bowing His head, He gave up His spirit.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:31: John 19:31 Therefore, because it was the Preparation Day, that the bodies should not remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a high day), the Jews asked Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:32: John 19:32 Then the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with Him.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:33: John 19:33 But when they came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead, they did not break His legs.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:34: John 19:34 But one of the soldiers pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:35: John 19:35 And he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows that he is telling the truth, so that you may believe.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:36: John 19:36 For these things were done that the Scripture should be fulfilled, "Not one of His bones shall be broken."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:37: John 19:37 And again another Scripture says, "They shall look on Him whom they pierced."(NKJV)
verses.john 19:38: John 19:38 After this, Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus; and Pilate gave him permission. So he came and took the body of Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:39: John 19:39 And Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:40: John 19:40 Then they took the body of Jesus, and bound it in strips of linen with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:41: John 19:41 Now in the place where He was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had yet been laid.(NKJV)
verses.john 19:42: John 19:42 So there they laid Jesus, because of the Jews' Preparation Day, for the tomb was nearby.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:1: John 20:1 Now on the first day of the week Mary Magdalene went to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:2: John 20:2 Then she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:3: John 20:3 Peter therefore went out, and the other disciple, and were going to the tomb.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:4: John 20:4 So they both ran together, and the other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:5: John 20:5 And he, stooping down and looking in, saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he did not go in.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:6: John 20:6 Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb; and he saw the linen cloths lying there,(NKJV)
verses.john 20:7: John 20:7 and the handkerchief that had been around His head, not lying with the linen cloths, but folded together in a place by itself.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:8: John 20:8 Then the other disciple, who came to the tomb first, went in also; and he saw and believed.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:9: John 20:9 For as yet they did not know the Scripture, that He must rise again from the dead.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:10: John 20:10 Then the disciples went away again to their own homes.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:11: John 20:11 But Mary stood outside by the tomb weeping, and as she wept she stooped down and looked into the tomb.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:12: John 20:12 And she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:13: John 20:13 Then they said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid Him."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:14: John 20:14 Now when she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, and did not know that it was Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:15: John 20:15 Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Whom are you seeking?" She, supposing Him to be the gardener, said to Him, "Sir, if You have carried Him away, tell me where You have laid Him, and I will take Him away."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:16: John 20:16 Jesus said to her, "Mary!" She turned and said to Him, "Rabboni!" (which is to say, Teacher).(NKJV)
verses.john 20:17: John 20:17 Jesus said to her, "Do not cling to Me, for I have not yet  ascended to My Father; but go to  My brethren and say to them,  "˜I am ascending to My Father and your Father, and to My God and your God.' "(NKJV)
verses.john 20:18: John 20:18 Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that He had spoken these things to her.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:19: John 20:19 Then, the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace be with you."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:20: John 20:20 When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:21: John 20:21 So Jesus said to them again, "Peace to you!  As the Father has sent Me, I also send you."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:22: John 20:22 And when He had said this, He breathed on them, and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:23: John 20:23 If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven them; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:24: John 20:24 Now Thomas, called the Twin, one of the twelve, was not with them when Jesus came.(NKJV)
verses.john 20:25: John 20:25 The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord." So he said to them, "Unless I see in His hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into His side, I will not believe."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:26: John 20:26 And after eight days His disciples were again inside, and Thomas with them. Jesus came, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace to you!"(NKJV)
verses.john 20:27: John 20:27 Then He said to Thomas, "Reach your finger here, and look at My hands; and  reach your hand here, and put it into My side. Do not be  unbelieving, but believing."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:28: John 20:28 And Thomas answered and said to Him, "My Lord and my God!"(NKJV)
verses.john 20:29: John 20:29 Jesus said to him, "Thomas, because you have seen Me, you have believed.  Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."(NKJV)
verses.john 20:30: John 20:30 And truly Jesus did many other signs in the presence of His disciples, which are not written in this book;(NKJV)
verses.john 20:31: John 20:31 but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in His name.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:1: John 21:1 After these things Jesus showed Himself again to the disciples at the Sea of Tiberias, and in this way He showed Himself:(NKJV)
verses.john 21:2: John 21:2 Simon Peter, Thomas called the Twin, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of His disciples were together.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:3: John 21:3 Simon Peter said to them, "I am going fishing." They said to him, "We are going with you also." They went out and immediately got into the boat, and that night they caught nothing.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:4: John 21:4 But when the morning had now come, Jesus stood on the shore; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:5: John 21:5 Then Jesus said to them, "Children, have you any food?" They answered Him, "No."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:6: John 21:6 And He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." So they cast, and now they were not able to draw it in because of the multitude of fish.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:7: John 21:7 Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his outer garment (for he had removed it), and plunged into the sea.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:8: John 21:8 But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from land, but about two hundred cubits), dragging the net with fish.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:9: John 21:9 Then, as soon as they had come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:10: John 21:10 Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have just caught."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:11: John 21:11 Simon Peter went up and dragged the net to land, full of large fish, one hundred and fifty-three; and although there were so many, the net was not broken.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:12: John 21:12 Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast." Yet none of the disciples dared ask Him, "Who are You?""”knowing that it was the Lord.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:13: John 21:13 Jesus then came and took the bread and gave it to them, and likewise the fish.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:14: John 21:14 This is now the third time Jesus showed Himself to His disciples after He was raised from the dead.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:15: John 21:15 So when they had eaten breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me more than these?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You." He said to him, "Feed My lambs."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:16: John 21:16 He said to him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" He said to Him, "Yes, Lord; You know that I love You."  He said to him, "Tend My  sheep."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:17: John 21:17 He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love Me?" Peter was grieved because He said to him the third time, "Do you love Me?" And he said to Him, "Lord, You know all things; You know that I love You." Jesus said to him, "Feed My sheep.(NKJV)
verses.john 21:18: John 21:18 Most assuredly, I say to you, when you were younger, you girded yourself and walked where you wished; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will gird you and carry you where you do not wish."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:19: John 21:19 This He spoke, signifying by what death he would glorify God. And when He had spoken this, He said to him, "Follow Me."(NKJV)
verses.john 21:20: John 21:20 Then Peter, turning around, saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following, who also had leaned on His breast at the supper, and said, "Lord, who is the one who betrays You?"(NKJV)
verses.john 21:21: John 21:21 Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, "But Lord, what about this man?"(NKJV)

verses.john 21:24: John 21:24 This is the disciple who testifies of these things, and wrote these things; and we know that his testimony is true.(NKJV)
